operatingModel: single developer; no per-packet authorization; stop at phase ends for Jani

packets.title: Bootstrap the workspace, CI and instruction files
packets.goal: Create the smallest buildable npm workspace with the package skeletons, strict TypeScript, Vitest, ESLint import boundaries, a `clanlab` stub, CI, and the production kit imported under docs/production. Record the actual environment.
accept: `npm ci && npm test && npm run lint` pass on a fresh clone; packages sim/content/lab and apps/web exist with README stubs and no game systems.
An import of `three`, `react` or a DOM type inside packages/sim fails lint; the failure is demonstrated and recorded.
.github/workflows/ci.yml runs build, lint, test, fixture subset and `tools/check_workboard.py`; a Playwright screenshot job exists but may be marked BLOCKED until W0-10.
state/STATUS.md records Node/npm/git versions, browser and GPU availability, and whether GitHub push works from the sandbox; state/ACCEPTED_BASELINE.json records the first commit.

packets.title: Primitives: checked integer math, units, rounding, serialization
packets.goal: Implement branded Int, checkedMath (add, sub, mul, divFloor, divCeil, mulDiv, isqrt) with safe-integer assertions, tick/millimeter/thousandths units, saved rate remainders and little-endian serialization.
accept: Known movement and need-rate vectors round as GDD 30.1–30.2 and D02 specify (ceil after single skill modifier; remainders carried).
Overflow past 2^53 and invalid units fail explicitly in test builds; `mulDiv` handles the millimeter-squared and thousandths products without overflow.
Serialization round-trips values and remainders byte-exactly; format version is recorded.
packets.refs: TP v2.0 §4; TP v1.1 §4; GDD 30.1–30.2; Addendum D02

packets.title: PRNG (sfc32), stream derivation and canonical hashing
packets.goal: Implement sfc32 with pinned test vectors generated from the reference implementation, splitmix32-based labeled stream derivation, and a 32-bit canonical hash (FNV-1a default) over little-endian serialization with two hash domains.
accept: Vectors identify algorithm, seeding rule and byte order; they are stored in the repository and match the implementation.
Adding an unused guest or cosmetic stream does not advance core streams; equal seeds give equal sequences across Node and a browser Worker (verified at W0-07/W0-10).
Equivalent data in different insertion order hashes identically; a changed consequential value changes the authoritative hash; observer data changes only the observer hash.

packets.title: Contracts v0 and dependency boundaries
packets.goal: Define PlayerCommand, CommandAck, ActionRequest/Result, ActorKnowledgeView, IPerceptionQuery, IRouteQuery, RouteResult, DamageProposal, DecisionTrace, CommittedEvent, RenderSnapshot, IStateSectionCodec, ContentProfile and FinalResult as TypeScript types plus JSON schemas, golden samples and the reason-ID registry.
accept: Golden JSON samples in contracts/samples validate against the schemas and round-trip through the codecs; rejection and unknown-version samples are rejected.
The architecture test proves ai/ cannot import core/ implementation and nothing in packages/sim imports rendering or DOM.

The reason registry contains at least the mandatory v0 IDs from INTERFACES.md, each with player text and required debug fields; contract version and change procedure are recorded in contracts/registry.json.

packets.title: Fixture DSL parser, semantic validation and assertion registry
packets.goal: Implement the fixture envelope (contracts/fixture.schema.json), semantic validation from FIXTURE_DSL.md, catalog profiles (Fixture/Prototype8/Trial24/Standard100) and the assertion registry (EventCountGte, EventCountEq, Invariant, HashEqualVariant) with UnsupportedAssertion failures.
accept: Unknown versions, fields, units, IDs and assertion kinds are rejected with typed errors before any world is constructed.
Setup-only state (precommitted laws, initial facts) is separated from validated player commands; a runtime law without 600 ticks of notice is rejected by the real validator path.
The three example fixtures parse; an EventCountGte with no matching events fails rather than passing empty.
packets.refs: contracts/FIXTURE_DSL.md; contracts/fixture.schema.json; TP v1.1 §19–20; Addendum D07

packets.title: clanlab run, summaries and failure bundles
packets.goal: Add `clanlab validate|run|inspect` as a Node CLI with JSON summaries, bounded log files and reproducible failure bundles.
accept: A deliberately failing fixture returns nonzero and writes a bundle that `clanlab inspect` reopens with the failing assertion, tick and evidence paths.
Machine output is valid JSON with build/contract/content identity, profile, seed, executed/failed/skipped/blocked counts and artifact paths; detailed logs stay in files.
Exit 0 only when every requested supported check passed; BLOCKED and skipped counts are visible.

packets.title: Minimal deterministic tick kernel and 137-actor synthetic workload (Node + Worker)
packets.goal: Implement the ten-stage tick loop skeleton, pause barrier and command queue with a synthetic motion and law-query workload for 136/137 actors, runnable in Node and in a Worker, with operation counters and canonical hashes.
accept: Same input tape produces equal authoritative hashes across repeated Node runs and between Node (`worker_threads`) and the browser Worker path (browser half verified in W0-10 via Playwright, recorded BLOCKED until then).
Pause and tick boundaries are explicit; stage order matches TP v1.1 §4 and is asserted by a fixture.
Counters (route-like queries, perception-like queries, actors) and wall-time per tick are reported with the workload's omissions listed; it is labeled synthetic and cannot satisfy FINALE 01.

packets.title: Persistence smoke: section container, IndexedDB adapter, exactly-once result key
packets.goal: Implement the versioned state-section container, a storage interface with in-memory, fake-indexeddb and browser IndexedDB adapters, two-generation durable saves, and a results store with unique-key add semantics.
accept: Snapshot load plus continuation matches the uninterrupted run's hashes for the synthetic kernel (Node adapters); corrupt or truncated generation leaves the previous valid generation intact.
Applying the same FinalResult twice increments once; a conflicting payload for the same key fails explicitly; a failed write is never acknowledged as saved.
The browser IndexedDB adapter passes the same suite under Playwright (recorded BLOCKED in the sandbox, executed in CI or on Jani's PC).
packets.refs: TP v2.0 §15; TP v1.1 §15; SAVE-ROUNDTRIP; DATA 01 foundation

packets.title: Readability renderer and clanlab render
packets.goal: Implement the deterministic 2D top-down render of any snapshot (terrain classes, law boundaries, actors as discs with clan ring, headwear glyph, action icon, nameplate) in packages/lab using node-canvas, expose `clanlab render`, and add the first readability assertions.
accept: `clanlab render --fixture <f> --tick <t> --out <png>` produces a PNG in the sandbox with metadata (fixture, tick, build hash) for the synthetic workload.
Readability assertions exist and run: nameplate overlap count below a threshold, clan ring contrast above a threshold, every action-state icon distinct; thresholds are recorded as TUNE.
The renderer is pure over the snapshot: same snapshot, same bytes.
packets.refs: TP v2.0 §13, §20; GDD 14; PRESENT 01 (first automated half)

packets.title: Web app shell: Vite, Worker bootstrap, tabletop camera, procedural identity kit, /capture, Playwright job
packets.goal: Create apps/web with the Worker bootstrap running the W0-07 kernel, a Three.js scene with the perspective tabletop camera, the procedural identity kit for eight recipes behind AppearanceRecipe, a watermarked FakeSim mode, the /capture route, and the Playwright screenshot job in CI.
accept: `npm run build` produces a static site; opening it runs the synthetic workload in a Worker at 1x/2x/4x with pause; the page shows the confirmed tick.

Eight supplied recipes render as distinguishable procedural characters (build, head, headwear, accessory, clan color, personal accent) at default tabletop distance; mesh bounds and attachment points are recorded.

`/capture?fixture=&tick=&camera=&textScale=` renders after warm-up frames and writes a PNG with metadata under Playwright in CI (BLOCKED_RENDER in the sandbox, recorded as such); FakeSim frames carry a visible watermark.
Browser Worker hashes equal Node hashes for the workload (closes the W0-07 blocked half).

packets.title: Integrate, G0 evidence, playtest brief, stop for Jani
packets.goal: Verify the integrated baseline, fill GATE_EVIDENCE.md for G0 with actual artifacts, produce the static build and PLAYTEST_BRIEF.md, record ADR 001 (web now, wrapper later), tag the baseline and stop.
accept: All W0 packets ACCEPTED after fresh-context self-review; `npm test`, fixtures, replay of the synthetic tape and the workboard check are green on the tagged baseline.
GATE_EVIDENCE.md lists each G0 criterion with PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/HUMAN_REQUIRED and artifact paths; blocked items name what Jani must run (JANI_PC_CHECKLIST.md).
state/STATUS.md contains the W0 metrics (sessions per packet, rework, blocked checks, time to first runnable slice); the developer stops and waits for Jani.

packets.title: Freeze first-playable action contracts
packets.goal: Extend contracts for world queries, action lifecycle, damage proposals and complete state sections before lanes branch.
accept: Shared requests, events, reason codes and codec versions have golden samples
Sim.Host composes providers without giving AI a world-state handle
Contract changes identify all consumer tests

packets.title: Terrain and fine geometry compiler
packets.goal: Compile the valley height field, traversal classes, camp fine cells and canonical geometry.
accept: Render and simulation exports share one geometry hash
Shallow water and impassable water match GDD speeds
Known start, work and obstacle coordinates match query results

packets.title: Spatial index and line of sight
packets.goal: Implement broad-phase neighbors and integer height-field LOS with deterministic counters.
accept: Occlusion, distance and boundary cases match geometry fixtures
A budget exhaustion result is explicit and never means visible by default
Static visibility means height/openness/cover, not hidden precomputed actor knowledge

packets.title: Knowledge-limited route segments
packets.goal: Implement hierarchical routes over known terrain with atomic bounded searches and certified partial progress.
accept: Concealed-route changes cannot change a route before observation
Complete, Partial, BudgetExhausted and NoKnownRoute remain distinct
Repeated partial requests either advance toward a certified portal or trigger bounded recovery

packets.title: Kinematic movement and obstacle sweep
packets.goal: Implement integer actor motion against terrain and structures without engine physics.
accept: No teleport, corner cutting or obstacle tunneling occurs
Speed and carry/shallow multipliers use saved remainders
Headless and rendered inputs produce identical movement hashes

packets.title: Local avoidance and passage queues
packets.goal: Add deterministic neighbor avoidance, passage ownership and stuck recovery.
accept: Opposing actors clear a narrow passage without overlap or permanent priority starvation
Intentional waits have triggers and deadlines
Unexplained lack of progress produces the ten-second diagnostic

packets.title: Inventory transactions
packets.goal: Implement typed stacks, weights, capacities and atomic transfers.
accept: Competing transfers cannot duplicate or overdraw a stack
Failed transfer changes neither inventory
Inventory state round-trips through its owned state section

packets.title: Reservations and lease lifecycle
packets.goal: Implement quantity/work-position leases and canonical atomic multi-key acquisition.
accept: One scarce item is granted once and the loser receives a reason
Fifty-tick leases renew only with valid progress
Cancel, death, departure and target invalidation release every owned handle

packets.title: Food consumption and starvation
packets.goal: Implement fullness rates, eating completion and hunger damage proposals.
accept: GDD food rates and item nutrition match fixed-point vectors
Interrupted eating consumes no item
Starvation damage remains distinct from hostile injury

packets.title: Fatigue rest and exertion
packets.goal: Implement fatigue, rest completion, stamina and work/speed restrictions.
accept: Thresholds and rest endpoint match the GDD
Emergency interruption preserves remaining fatigue and stamina
No actor loses ordinary walking merely because sprint stamina is exhausted

packets.title: Day night and exposure
packets.goal: Implement the five-day calendar, exposure rates, shelter/fire/cloak mitigation and recovery.
accept: Night boundaries and twilight authority match TIME 01
Ordinary four-minute night and two-minute cold overlap match exposure vectors
Visual light settings cannot change exposure or illumination facts

packets.title: Permission service and law intervals
packets.goal: Implement typed global permission intervals, legal action start, effect checks and version invalidation.
accept: Start-inclusive and end-exclusive boundaries are consistent
New law wins over same-tick action resolution
Denied action produces no effect and retains a truthful reason

packets.title: Sanctuary and protected injury state
packets.goal: Implement bidirectional region protection and source-aware bleed/status handling.
accept: Attacker or target inside sanctuary blocks sentient harm
Boundary points are included
Wildlife/needs remain active while covered hostile bleed timers pause

packets.title: Belief records and provenance
packets.goal: Implement typed observations, received reports, staleness and deterministic eviction.
accept: Reports retain original observed time and uncertainty
Active obligations survive ordinary belief eviction
Stale enemy position does not become a fresh exact coordinate

packets.title: Sensory adapter and isolation
packets.goal: Connect lawful sensory queries to ActorKnowledgeView and public arena notices.
accept: Hidden enemies, stores and concealed routes do not change decisions
Sight/light/concealment/sleep and hearing channels match the GDD
Urgent threat evidence is delivered within five ticks

packets.title: Utility scoring and decision traces
packets.goal: Implement normalized considerations, traits, commitment hysteresis and trace snapshots.
accept: One-trait paired fixtures change only relevant considerations
Chosen and actually evaluated alternatives retain reason and evidence age
Emergency/legal invalidation bypasses ordinary switching delay

packets.title: Action executor lifecycle
packets.goal: Implement one generic executor for travel, work, interruption, revalidation and atomic completion.
accept: Invalid range, permission or lease cancels with a typed failure
Actions do not apply effects through animation events
Every active field is captured by its state-section codec

packets.title: Food and rest task methods
packets.goal: Implement bounded AcquireFood and Rest methods using known sources and actual resources.
accept: Hungry actor gathers and eats reachable food without unrelated detours
Missing or reserved source yields an alternative or exploration
Plans finish or report a meaningful failure; no generic idle loop

packets.title: Timed waiting and law amendment response
packets.goal: Implement explicit waits, earliest/latest useful start and dependency versions.
accept: Patient actor may wait while an immediate-need profile selects a feasible alternative
Amended expiry invalidates the old wait within ten ticks
Permission opening still requires the normal attack wind-up

packets.title: Socket construction and input milestones
packets.goal: Implement one Hearth and shelter build path with consumed-input ledgers and legal work positions.
accept: Half-progress consumption and unfinished salvage conserve inputs
Two actors cannot claim the same socket
Filling prototype sockets preserves the required work routes and exits

packets.title: Projectile segment collision
packets.goal: Implement swept projectile intersections, height, obstacle blocking and stable first contact.
accept: An 18 m/s arrow cannot tunnel through an actor between ticks
First obstacle/contact ordering is stable
Collision output alone applies no damage

packets.title: Combat preparation and contact
packets.goal: Implement melee/bow preparation, resource use, recovery and permission-checked hit proposals.
accept: Prohibited attacks cannot precharge an instant hit
Launch and impact checks both enforce current rules
Stamina, arrows, range and facing follow GDD values

packets.title: Simultaneous damage and health states
packets.goal: Implement support-before-damage resolution, standing-to-downed transitions and source attribution.
accept: Entity iteration order does not alter health results
Multiple same-tick hits down a standing target once, without also eliminating it
Eligible aid completion and later damage use the agreed boundary semantics

packets.title: Revival bleed and elimination cleanup
packets.goal: Implement downed timers, bandage revival, finish actions and cleanup.
accept: Protection pauses only covered sentient-origin bleed
Revival consumes one bandage at completion and resets the episode
Elimination releases leases and produces carried drops once

packets.title: Immediate threat fallback and prototype wildlife
packets.goal: Implement simple flee/fight policies for contestants and one wolf/deer fixture.
accept: Observed stronger threat interrupts work within five ticks
Wildlife remains dangerous during sentient Truce
The species policy never reads the observer selection or hidden target state

packets.title: Eight-person prototype catalog
packets.goal: Author eight existing GDD identities, a declared recipe subset, action cues and 40 initial situation keys.
accept: Prototype profile validates without weakening Standard requirements
Every implemented action has intent, icon, animation and sound-or-silent mapping
Authored data uses GDD identity/skill/trait values and explicit units

packets.title: Snapshot bridge and interpolation ownership
packets.goal: Replace FakeSim view bindings with the real snapshot protocol and proven buffer ownership.
accept: Renderer holds one shared read buffer and a local previous-sample cache
Slow rendering cannot mutate or block the core through a held buffer
Pause settles to the acknowledged tick; data age is visible
packets.webAdaptation: Worker postMessage bridge with transferable buffers (TP v2.0 §3).

packets.title: Twelve procedural action motions
packets.goal: Implement all twelve action states with tools, carrying cues and interruption overlays.
accept: Rest, wait, blocked work, combat and rescue remain visually distinct
No motion or particle event creates gameplay effects
Day/night and close/wide images pass the presentation checklist
packets.webAdaptation: Three.js per-instance attributes and state icons; no animation clips (TP v2.0 §13).

packets.title: Selection follow and inspection
packets.goal: Implement picking, five follow slots, one Focus and essential contestant panels.
accept: Keyboard and pointer select the same intended entity
Personal identity survives clan color changes
Scaling to 150 percent preserves critical labels and controls
packets.webAdaptation: React components over view models; the W0-09 readability renderer becomes the overview map.

packets.title: Law timeline and player command UI
packets.goal: Implement pause/speed controls, law previews, pending commands and acknowledgement feedback.
accept: UI never displays a rejected law as active
Pending paused commands remain visibly pending
Actual delivered speed is shown when requested acceleration is unsustainable
packets.webAdaptation: React components; keyboard and text scale from CSS (TP v2.0 §14).

packets.title: Why panel and event feed
packets.goal: Bind readable reasons to recorded decision candidates and evidence ages.
accept: Displayed alternatives are exactly a subset of evaluated trace entries
No evaluated alternative means an explicit unavailable explanation
Off-camera events enter the feed without changing bot knowledge
packets.webAdaptation: React components; Why panel reads DecisionTrace verbatim (TP v2.0 §14).

packets.title: Compose the first real simulation host
packets.goal: Wire completed providers into Sim.Host and use it in the console and Godot clients.
accept: Both frontends use identical provider registrations and content
No placeholder action or FakeSim feeds player-facing claims
The valley runs real survival, building and law behavior

packets.title: Complete first-playable save and replay
packets.goal: Register all implemented state sections and test whole-host checkpoint continuation.
accept: Save/load reproduces the next 600 ticks
Random checkpoint ticks and 10/60-second frequencies preserve hashes
Missing state sections fail validation instead of loading defaults
packets.webAdaptation: IndexedDB adapter in the browser, in-memory/fake-indexeddb in Node; JSON export/import (TP v2.0 §15).

packets.title: First-playable and population evidence
packets.goal: Run G1 scenarios, production-query stress counts, screenshot checks and new-viewer observation.
accept: Eight contestants complete meaningful tasks with traceable reasons
All G1-mapped scenes execute; omitted full-game behaviors are listed
136/137-actor counters and actual rendering evidence are separate

packets.title: Integrate and request G1 approval
packets.goal: Produce the first-playable accepted candidate, evidence index and next-phase dispatch.
accept: All P1 returns have independent review and integrated evidence
Jani receives executable/source archives and a short test path
P2 starts only after the recorded G1 approval

packets.title: Freeze Trial and social contracts
packets.goal: Freeze the 30-minute Trial calendar, social transactions, taught knowledge and reported evidence contracts.
accept: Addendum D08 is encoded without scaling survival rates
Public notices and private messages have distinct payloads
Golden samples cover interrupted and completed social actions

packets.title: Procedure ownership and teaching
packets.goal: Implement basic versus learned procedures, teaching completion and loss of access.
accept: Interrupted teaching grants no knowledge
Teacher loss never removes basics or invents recipes
Completed lesson records teacher, learner, procedure and tick

packets.title: Tool and production task methods
packets.goal: Implement short crafting dependencies, tool selection and missing-procedure alternatives.
accept: Missing tool leads to a conserved gather/craft/use chain
Known incapable recipe is not retried forever
Planned quantities account for reservations and carried weight

packets.title: Clan membership and departure
packets.goal: Implement initial solo clans, invitations, capacity checks, departure notice and rejoin cooldown.
accept: Eight living members includes downed members
Ten-second departure and fifteen-second protection obey future lock truncation
Simultaneous joins cannot exceed capacity or duplicate membership

packets.title: Votes customs and succession
packets.goal: Implement fixed-electorate votes, custom adoption, leadership succession and notice delivery.
accept: Absent votes never become consent
Uninformed members cannot knowingly violate a new custom
Leader death selects the documented successor and releases stale plan ownership

packets.title: Agreements and useful aid facts
packets.goal: Implement explicit commitments, betrayal facts, useful food/medicine aid and trade completion.
accept: Betrayal requires an obligation known to the actor
Empty swaps produce no useful-aid credit
Failed exchange conserves both sides and records a truthful reason

packets.title: Trust and message propagation
packets.goal: Implement bounded relationships and communicated reports with original provenance.
accept: Speaker proximity, attendance and interruption govern delivery
Repeat reports do not become firsthand observations
Trust changes cite actual conduct and one event cannot be applied twice

packets.title: Cooperation and contribution planning
packets.goal: Implement proposed clan work priorities, individual acceptance and shared reservation coordination.
accept: Leader suggestions remain optional individual decisions
A remote member does not receive instant private inventory knowledge
Unfilled roles trigger recovery without overriding personal survival

packets.title: Rescue and covering choices
packets.goal: Implement rescue, cover, retreat and refusal from observed risk and relationships.
accept: Paired loyal and cautious profiles produce defensible different choices
No bandage or blocked route is recognized as infeasible
Threat interruptions cannot strand a permanent rescue lease

packets.title: Alliance departure and opportunism policies
packets.goal: Implement bounded alliance invitations, departures and commitment-aware opportunistic choices.
accept: Actors may wait for a law or depart before an attack legally
No betrayal is forced for narrative variety
Different policies still meet basic survival competence

packets.title: Rest guard and wildlife group policies
packets.goal: Complete guard rotations, deer flight and wolf threat policies using species-specific observations.
accept: Sleeping guards receive reduced lawful sensory evidence
Three contrasting contestants respond differently to a wolf during Truce
Wildlife work uses separate streams and no contestant career slot

packets.title: Trial24 content profile
packets.goal: Author the 24-person Trial identity set, declared recipes and deterministic opening valley variations.
accept: Every identity is an existing roster ID with authored profiles
Trial24 history is separate from Standard
Recipe profile dependencies are closed and content hash is stable

packets.title: Trial world generation and route timing
packets.goal: Generate seeded Trial terrain and validate starts, food, camp access and strategic route times.
accept: All starts have reachable opening food within 45 seconds and a camp opportunity within 90 seconds under the stated model
Route reports use actual 3.5 m/s base speed and terrain costs
Sampled strategic diameter is labeled as sampled and failures reject the seed

packets.title: Paid intervention scheduler
packets.goal: Implement six Influence, notice, duration, overlap limits and paid amendments.
accept: Rejected commands spend nothing and accepted amendments are accounted once
Future overlap is validated over intervals, not only at submission
Trial and Standard use distinct latest-start/expiry windows

packets.title: Regional hazard placement validation
packets.goal: Implement Storm Warning escape connectivity and region boundary queries.
accept: A hazard that disconnects required safe components is rejected
New geometry is revalidated at defined activation boundaries
Overlapping hazards expose maximum rate without double counting

packets.title: Information and environment power effects
packets.goal: Implement Herald, Cold Front, Bountiful Ground and Storm Warning from typed scheduled commands.
accept: Herald reads activation-time authorized bands and never retargets
Environmental rates match typed tuning and conservation rules
Every effect expires at the validated tick and produces source events

packets.title: Trial pressure and ending director
packets.goal: Implement the Trial calendar, shrinking refuge, membership lock and simultaneous result resolution.
accept: Thirty-minute Trial ends at its own cutoff without creating Standard credit
Marker occupancy never awards a win
All-downed and all-dead cases follow the same health/result rules as Standard

packets.title: Compose Trial host and profile
packets.goal: Register the complete Trial providers and profile in both frontends.
accept: Real Trial has no fake provider
Profile, recipe and law versions are recorded in every run
Provider ownership and serialized sections are audited before persistence expands

packets.title: Trial save journals and branch provenance
packets.goal: Persist all new social, director, knowledge and wildlife state and implement input replay branches.
accept: Random checkpoints reproduce full-host continuation
Journal truncation recovers only confirmed records
Continuing a finalized earlier checkpoint becomes a distinct practice branch

packets.title: Career finalization and combat attribution
packets.goal: Implement roster career projection and correct downing/revival damage episode accounting.
accept: Unique result key makes repeated finalization idempotent
Episode reset after revival or thirty seconds without damage prevents stale assist credit
Tutorial, Trial, Standard, Custom and Story records remain identifiable
packets.webAdaptation: IndexedDB `results` store with add semantics for exactly-once (TP v2.0 §15).

packets.title: Forecast state and factual resolution
packets.goal: Implement eight templates, three slots, deadlines, sticky influence and observer-only persistence.
accept: Only events after creation through the deadline count
Accepted later world commands mark influence permanently; rejected commands do not
Forecasts, notes and camera toggles do not change any authoritative hash
packets.webAdaptation: Observer store in IndexedDB with its own hash domain (TP v2.0 §15).

packets.title: Trial social and observer interface
packets.goal: Add clan membership, public power previews, career result and forecast controls with real data.
accept: Consent, unknown evidence and refused plans are distinguishable
All eight powers expose cost, notice, region and expiry before submission
Forecast outcome links reach the supporting event and correct run

packets.title: Trial invariants and paired behavior batch
packets.goal: Run the full Trial suite, 100 varied seeds, save perturbations and paired profile fixtures.
accept: Every failure yields a replayable package
Legal but poor survival metrics remain visible and distinct from invariant failures
No hidden-state leakage, duplicate result or endless route restart is accepted

packets.title: Comprehension capture and observation kit
packets.goal: Prepare a repeatable short session, neutral questions and screen recordings for ten new viewers.
accept: Jani can run the study without coaching answers
Report records observed recall, causal explanations and next-law understanding
Missing participants remain HUMAN_REQUIRED and invented feedback is prohibited

packets.title: Trial performance and player evidence review
packets.goal: Evaluate the reference-machine Trial and aggregate the real comprehension study.
accept: At least eight of ten new viewers meet the GDD recall/explanation/next-law threshold
Failed comprehension requires repair packets and a fresh check, not a pass with a repair plan
CPU, GPU, counters and actual delivered acceleration are recorded separately

packets.title: Integrate and request G2 approval
packets.goal: Publish one integrated Trial candidate and dispatch the bounded full-Standard wave.
accept: G2 is tied to the exact reviewed candidate and content hash
All required evidence exists or the phase remains blocked
Jani explicitly approves P3 before new implementation starts

packets.title: Freeze Standard Custom and history extensions
packets.goal: Freeze full population, Custom command restrictions, scenario format and endgame region contracts.
accept: Shipping Custom scope includes two commandments and three structured whispers
Standard and Story provenance cannot be relabeled by a UI field
Extensions include golden valid and invalid samples

packets.title: Roster100 and complete recipe catalog
packets.goal: Author the remaining roster and exactly 28 shipping recipes including ten structures.
accept: All 100 identities are unique and statistically bounded
Recipe dependencies, costs and durations match the GDD manifest
No missing-role fallback silently substitutes duplicate personalities

packets.title: Full island compiler and opening validation
packets.goal: Expand generation to the Standard world with legal camps, materials and six-minute aggregate starting supply.
accept: Generation validates opening access and all strategic anchor routes
Report gives actual travel-time distribution rather than geometric distance alone
Invalid seeds are deterministically rejected with bounded retries

packets.title: Full camp sockets and demolition routes
packets.goal: Validate every structure footprint and work position for full camps and Hearth loss.
accept: Filled camps keep required work routes and exits
Demolition updates geometry versions and only encountered obstacles enter private knowledge
Hearth loss leaves clan identity intact

packets.title: Full crafting harvest and salvage actions
packets.goal: Complete the recipe executor families and consumed-material recovery semantics.
accept: Every manifest recipe has one legal execution route
Salvage is based on actually consumed inputs and rounded as specified
Interruptions at both consumption milestones conserve every item

packets.title: Settlement expansion and production priorities
packets.goal: Implement autonomous modular expansion, shortage response and learned-procedure alternatives.
accept: Bots choose affordable legal sockets and maintain access
Hoarding or building cannot suppress urgent food and exposure needs
A clan can recover useful production after losing its only specialist

packets.title: Scouting trade raids and retreat methods
packets.goal: Complete bounded expedition and conflict methods driven by observed stores and threats.
accept: Preparation evaluates time to permission and safe return
Retreat releases reservations and preserves truthful commitments
Rumored stockpiles remain uncertain and cannot become exact hidden inventories

packets.title: Standard calendar and terminal policies
packets.goal: Install the exact 60-minute calendar, protection cutoff and terminal damage policy.
accept: All listed boundaries occur at exact Standard ticks
Healing is disabled and downing bypassed during terminal pressure
Forced elimination at tick 36000 precedes winner evaluation

packets.title: Refuge contraction and population routes
packets.goal: Implement staged shrinking geometry and congestion fixtures for all 100 contestants.
accept: No forced bracket assignment or teleports resolve traffic
All collision and damage semantics remain active off-camera
Opposing routes and simultaneous arrivals recover without deadlock

packets.title: Migration and final survival policies
packets.goal: Implement forecasted travel deadlines, supplies, route alternatives and final conflict decisions.
accept: Late departure is explained by evaluated tradeoffs or recorded failure
Agents never reason from hidden occupancy or unrealized future clan membership
Passive coalitions still resolve by legal terminal rules

packets.title: Compose complete Standard host
packets.goal: Register the production population, world, recipes and director in the common host.
accept: 100 contestants plus 36 wildlife use production providers
Catalog and geometry hashes agree in client and lab
No prototype conditional bypasses a required rule

packets.title: Custom commands and scenario provenance
packets.goal: Implement unrestricted supported law durations/instant changes, approved resource placement and finite/open-ended Custom endings.
accept: Every supported Custom command still passes range, schema and quantity validation
Importing unknown scenario content cannot create Standard records
